name: Industry threat intelligence report
description: Produces a sector-specific threat report, from executive summary through threat landscape, notable incidents, regulation, attacker motivations, sector challenges, recommendations and case studies. Use it for leadership or board briefings on threats to your industry.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Date range
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Period the report covers, shown in its title, e.g. 'Q3 2026' or 'last 90 days'.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to the stakeholder teams.

name: Threat trend identification
description: Identifies and ranks the top threat trends for a reporting period by evidence weight, each backed by at least three traceable data points, with analyst-commentary placeholders for implications and outlook. Use it for the data-heavy part of a recurring threat report.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the structured data (events, tickets, CVEs, reports with their identifiers) to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to the stakeholder teams.

name: Structured threat assessment
description: Produces a structured assessment of one threat: operational environment, attack surface, threat profile with ATT&CK techniques, most likely and worst case scenarios, recommended actions, intelligence gaps and a handoff quick reference. Use it to serve the SOC (detectable kill chain) and leadership (two-sentence summary) at once.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Threat
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Threat actor, malware, campaign or vulnerability to assess. Leave empty to use the threat the source material describes.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Critical systems
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Your critical systems and key dependencies. Leave empty to use the Critical systems line of the agent's Organization context, or get a generalized assessment.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to the stakeholder teams.

name: Geopolitical implications of cyberattacks
description: Writes a long-form report on a threat actor's recent campaigns through a geopolitical lens: BLUF, multilingual source analysis, actor profile, escalation and political response forecasts, sector risk forecast and indicators to watch. Use it when geopolitical risk affects your operations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse, in any language. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Threat actor
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The threat actor whose campaigns to analyse. Leave empty to use the actor the source material describes.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to the stakeholder teams.

name: Tariffs monitoring update
description: Produces a structured update on recent tariff developments: overview, a table of enacted and proposed tariffs, outlook on timelines, escalation and supply-chain impact, and takeaways with monitoring indicators. Use it to brief procurement, vendor risk and leadership on policy-driven business risk.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the news articles or notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect current news from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Tariffs to monitor
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Which tariffs to cover, e.g. 'U.S. tariffs' or 'EU-China tariffs on electric vehicles'.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Reporting period
manual_trigger_parameters.description: How recent the news should be.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to the stakeholder teams.
